item.description:
DynamicNotch 10.0

  • 淦！忘记改build了
  • 还是修Workflow oobe完了自动启用hud replace
  • 依旧修Workflow
  • 修Workflow
  • 我就要从10.0开始发版本号！
  • feat(onboarding): add launch at login step to OOBE and restore standard HIG app icon
  • feat(onboarding): add launch at login step to OOBE and restore standard HIG app icon
  • chore(updater): consolidate appcast feed under website and support b2 mirror
  • fix(media): eliminate priority inversion by using async continuation and explicit QoS
  • fix(media): enhance media key interceptor with watchdog, auto-recovery and wake handling
  • fix(i18n): fix settings and onboarding localizations, remove face animation hack
  • fix(shelf): resolve drag and drop failure by using standard bookmark options and optimizing drop routing
  • fix(interceptor): isolate MediaKeyInterceptor on dedicated thread and recover from timeouts
  • refactor: remove webcam feature and update localized resources
  • feat: add bluetooth device connection activities and improve artwork synchronization
  • refactor: remove DynamicNotchXPCHelper and clean up unused resources
  • fix(website): persist the language preference only on manual switch
  • chore(website): consolidate the site under website/ and drop Windows/SkyLight copy
  • chore: drop upstream governance files and rebrand the issue templates
  • ci: add a fork-scoped notarization release pipeline
  • fix(signing): rotate the Sparkle EdDSA key and harden the XPC helper
  • docs: move copyright out of LICENSE so GitHub keeps the GPL-3.0 badge
  • docs(license): trim the copyright preamble to the canonical GPL notice
  • docs: rebrand license, add Code of Conduct, update security policy
  • feat: ship DynamicNotch 1.2 with its own update feed
  • fix: resolve sneak peek alert popdown, expand notch height and localize playback sources
  • fix(music): restore sneak peek alert on track change; remove shortcut system and redundant text; add i18n for playback sources
  • refactor: eliminate XPC service dependency and inline helper logic in-process
  • fix: disable app sandbox and add inner padding to notch wings
  • chore: update Localizable.xcstrings
